title: Data & ML Ops Lead
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.
About the role
At Gravis, the intelligence behind our machines is only as good as the systems that develop, train, and operate it. The Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into a learning-based control system that adapts in real time to changing ground conditions. As our fleet grows and our models become more sophisticated, we need world-class infrastructure to support the full ML lifecycle: from raw sensor data ingestion on the edge to continuous model training, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

title: Senior ML Performance Engineer, Inference Optimisation
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our ML performance team optimises inference for edge accelerators and GPUs, so large transformer-based models run efficiently on low-cost, low-power in-vehicle compute. We work closely with model, platform and deployment teams to turn research models into reliable production systems for Wayve's driving product.

🧠 Your day-to-day

This is a hands-on role across ML systems, compilers, runtimes, kernels and embedded deployment. You'll find bottlenecks, implement performance improvements, and work with model developers on performance trade-offs so deployment-aware decisions are made early.

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Profiling inference performance across model graphs, compiler/runtime behaviour, kernel execution and memory movement

- Implementing and validating optimisations in compilers, runtimes and/or kernels, including fusion, scheduling, quantisation-aware performance and custom kernels

- Building benchmarking and regression tests to track performance across models, devices and software releases

- Optimising for edge targets such as NVIDIA Orin/Thor and Qualcomm platforms

- Contributing to team tooling, documentation and technical discussions around ML performance

🙌 You should apply if

- You have experience improving performance in production or production-adjacent systems with latency, memory, bandwidth, power, thermal or cost constraints

- You have strong hands-on experience with at least one relevant stack, such as TensorRT, CUDA, Qualcomm QNN, Triton or OpenCL

- You are comfortable working from high-level model behaviour down to kernel/runtime-level execution

- You have strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, profiling, testing and maintainable code

- You communicate clearly and work well across ML, systems and deployment teams

Nice to have:

- Experience deploying or benchmarking ML models on embedded or edge devices

- Familiarity with NVIDIA and/or Qualcomm SoCs and performance tooling

- Python and C++ proficiency

- Experience supporting other engineers or contributing to technical direction within a small team

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. title: Program Manager
description:

Easy Dynamics designs, builds, and secures the systems that protect our people, places, and way of life. We are a trusted advisor delivering best-in-class technology solutions in Digital Identity, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management. Our teams combine engineering excellence with a disciplined, forward-leaning approach to solve our clients' hardest technical challenges. We bring an “East Coast address, West Coast attitude” to everything we do, combining mission focus with an innovative, collaborative, and flexible culture that puts people first. Our subject matter experts work at the cutting edge of cybersecurity and technology, delivering identity management, cloud, and security automation solutions that directly impact critical government missions. We believe the best work happens when talented people have the freedom and support to do what they do best.
We don't run on rigid hierarchy or playbooks that are locked in once and expected to work for the rest of time. We're a company of self-starters who take ownership without being asked twice and treat ambiguity as room to run rather than a roadblock. Our practice is growing quickly, and our structure stays intentionally light so ideas can move fast and the people closest to the work have real say in how it gets done. That means this role comes with genuine latitude to shape how we deliver, and outsized opportunity for impact on both our clients and our team.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid, 2 days WFH) | 💰 £45,000 - £55,000

Street Group is a fast-moving B2B SaaS business, grown in Manchester but on a UK-wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We're PE-backed and scaling fast with an ambitious growth plan, and we're looking for an FP&A Analyst to help us get there.

As we grow, our revenue streams are becoming more varied by the month. That means more reporting, more complexity, and a finance function that needs to proactively help drive growth.

This is an opportunity to help expand a new FP&A function, you won't be slotting into a fixed process. You'll be shaping it while owning the data and supporting the models that feed our board packs and investor reporting.

If you want ownership early, enjoy explaining what the numbers mean as much as producing them, and already use AI to take the manual work out of finance, we think you might do great work here.

Why this role exists now

We're growing quickly, and our finance team is growing with us. As our revenue streams expand, so does the appetite for clear, timely insight from our board and investors. That's where you come in. Join us early, help shape how FP&A works here, and see your work make a real difference from day one.

The role

You'll work closely with our FP&A Lead and the wider finance team, owning the data behind our FP&A outputs and turning it into insight the business can act on.

Day-to-day, that means owning our performance trackers and reporting models, drafting the monthly board and management packs, and supporting VCP performance and reporting. You'll help implement new tools and own the data behind them, build dashboards to track commercial and financial performance, and reconcile data across multiple systems so everything stays accurate and consistent.

You'll also support three-statement modelling and our annual budget and rolling forecast cycles, and pick up ad hoc commercial insight and improvement projects as they come up. Throughout, you'll use Claude to automate routine reporting and modelling, so your time goes on the insight that matters.

Who we're looking for

- 2-4 years in an FP&A, commercial finance or analytical role, and part-qualified or newly qualified (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).

- A meticulous and detail-driven individual with a strict commitment to accuracy and precision in all financial modelling and reporting.

- Experience building driver-based models for budgets and forecasts, and producing management information or board and management packs.

- A solid understanding of double-entry and comfort with three-statement modelling.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas and sensitivity and scenario modelling.

- An AI-native mindset: you already use Claude, Copilot or a similar tool in your finance work, and you would rather simplify and automate a manual process than plough through it.

- The ability to explain numbers in plain language to non-finance stakeholders.

title: Account Manager
description:
About Shippabo

Shippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder. Founded in 2016, we have raised $22 million from Wonder Ventures, TenOneTen Ventures, Double M Partners, and Slow Ventures. Our platform gives importers one place to book, track, and manage ocean shipments, with their internal teams and their overseas suppliers working from the same data. Behind the platform sits a real forwarding operation: a dedicated ocean contracts and pricing team that negotiates carrier rates, and a team in China that works directly with shippers at origin. We’re about 40 people across the US, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, and China. Our engineering team builds the software that makes the operation faster and more transparent than a traditional forwarder can be.
About the role
This is an account management role built around retention, service quality, and problem solving. It’s not a quota-carrying sales job. There’s no cross-sell or upsell target, and no cold outbound. The one exception is re-engaging importers who have gone quiet or moved volume elsewhere, where the goal is to understand what went wrong and win the volume back. What we actually need is someone who can look at an account and a shipment and figure out what is really going on, then drive it to resolution without needing to hand it off.
What you’ll do
Own a portfolio of importer accounts. You are the primary relationship owner for a book of existing importers. You are accountable for retention, satisfaction, and the health of the relationship over time.
Diagnose before you escalate. When a client raises an issue, your first job is to determine what kind of issue it is. Is it a rate problem, a service failure, an expectation that was set wrong, or a process that broke internally? The answer determines who needs to be involved and what the fix is. We want you to make that call, not pass it off to someone else.
Review shipments and catch problems early. You should be able to look at a booking and know when something is off before the customer tells you. Rolled bookings, a vessel schedule change that will miss a delivery window, drayage constraints at the port of discharge, a document mismatch that will hold a container at customs. You’ll know when to dig into carrier schedules, customs entry, drayage, or documentation, and when it is normal activity not worth alarming a customer over.
Balance the client and the business. Understand what each importer is optimizing for, whether that’s landed cost, transit reliability, or predictability, and weigh that against what makes commercial sense for Shippabo . Advocate hard for the client, and be honest internally about what we got wrong.
Drive quote acceptance and forecast accuracy. Make sure forecasted volume actually books, quotes are accepted or the reason they were not is understood, and that feedback goes back to the supply/pricing team so our rates stay competitive on the lanes that matter.
Own outcomes across teams. Many customer requests require Product, Operations, Finance, or the origin team in China. You’re the owner of the outcome. You map the steps, set the timeline, follow up, and close the loop with the customer.
Monitor and report on your portfolio. Track operational and revenue metrics across your accounts. Surface trends, at-risk accounts, and volume shifts before they become surprises.
Serve as an advisor, not an order taker. Educate importers on supply chain practices and on what Shippabo 's platform and network can do for them. Communicate market conditions, rate trends, surcharges, and capacity shifts in terms of what they mean for that specific customer’s business.
Handle inbound small and new importer leads. Own inbound marketing leads from smaller importers, qualify them, and get them onboarded and running.
Re-engage churned and dormant accounts. Work through importers who have reduced or stopped shipping with us, understand why, and rebuild the relationship where the fit is still there.

SOFTSWISS is growing, and we are seeking a skilled Application Security Engineer to join our team. If you are driven by excellence and share our values, we would love to hear from you.

Our goal is to make sure that we deploy secure software to production without unnecessary bottlenecks, that applications are properly hardened, and security vulnerabilities, once discovered, are fixed by the developers.
As an Application Security Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security of our applications throughout the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with the product teams to identify, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities, contributing to the creation of trustworthy and robust products.
Key responsibilities:

• Partner with product teams during the design phase to facilitate threat modeling and risk assessment sessions.

• Perform in-depth manual code reviews on critical applications to identify logical vulnerabilities as part of white-box security assessments.

• Tune and adjust rulesets for automated security scanning tools to reduce false positives and improve detection rates.

• Develop scripts and automation tools to streamline workflows and free up time for more complex analysis.

• Assist developers in understanding security risks and threats discovered during risk assessments, threat modeling, and dynamic testing.

• Triage vulnerabilities from the bug bounty program, collaborating with external researchers and internal engineering teams to resolve discovered flaws.

• Knowledge of secure system and application architecture alongside secure-by-design principles.

• Practical, hands-on expertise in identifying vulnerabilities through manual security assessments and secure code reviews.

• Ability to clearly articulate and explain the business impact of identified threats and vulnerabilities to developers and product teams.

title: E-Commerce Platform Specialist
description:
Our US Partner is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Platform Specialist to own the day-to-day operation of their e-commerce platform portfolio. The ideal candidate will manage a proprietary branded store platform built in-house, as well as a third-party enterprise e-commerce platform used for complex client deployments.
This role requires strong technical execution, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, sales departments, and enterprise clients. You will spend most of your time inside the platforms building, configuring, and troubleshooting configurations independently.
This is a full-time role, on a US shift and on a Work From Home set-up.
If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Platform Operations (70%)

• Build, configure, and launch branded client stores on both internal and external e-commerce platforms.

• Handle HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript customizations independently, without escalating to the development team.

• Configure products, categories, pricing, access rules, approval workflows, and checkout settings per client.

• Manage Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations with client identity providers, including Azure AD.

• Maintain and monitor integrations with warehouse, fulfillment, and ERP systems.

• Troubleshoot platform issues, isolate root causes, and resolve or escalate them efficiently.

• Use Git for version control when working on the internal platform codebase.

• Keep platform records current, including store specifications, configuration decisions, and onboarding runbooks.

Client and Sales Support (20%)

• Serve as the operational point of contact for active store clients, handling configuration requests, asset updates, and reporting.

• Work alongside the sales team to scope new store requirements before commitments are made to a client.

• Translate client briefs into concrete platform configurations, flagging what is native, what needs custom work, and what is out of scope.

• Support store launches end-to-end, covering requirements gathering, building, QA, and final go-live execution.

Roadmap and Migrations (10%)

• Feed the internal platform roadmap with client and operational requirements, working closely with the Head of Technology and front-end developers.

• Plan and execute migrations of existing client stores from legacy platforms like Magento and Shopify onto the current platform stack.

• Inventory existing store configurations, product catalogs, and integrations before initiating migrations.

• Manage content and data transfers, re-platforming workflows seamlessly where necessary.

Required Experience & Technical Skills

• 3+ years of hands-on experience operating or building e-commerce stores across multiple platforms.

• Direct experience with Magento (Open Source or Commerce) and Shopify, including configuration, theming, product setup, and migrations.

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript with the ability to make layout, styling, and functional changes independently.

• Comfortable utilizing Git for version control at a basic operational level.

• Proven experience configuring SSO integrations (Azure AD / SAML 2.0).

• Deep understanding of e-commerce platform architecture, including routing, templates, product catalogs, variants, and checkout flows.

• Ability to read and interpret code well enough to debug without always relying on a developer.

• Conceptual understanding of integrations (APIs, webhooks, and system connectivity) without needing to build them from scratch.

Professional & Behavioral Skills

• Strong operational instincts with a proactive, can-do attitude-you close loops, document actions, and do not need to be chased.

• Comfortable working directly and professionally with enterprise clients and sales teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Storage Platform
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our AI Platform Teams

Our AI Platform teams build the infrastructure that powers Wayve’s embodied AI. We store and serve hundreds of petabytes of driving data, growing towards exabyte scale, to support model training, simulation and data pipelines across regions and clouds.

As our first dedicated Staff Software Engineer for Storage Platform, you’ll set the technical direction for how we manage, protect and serve this data. Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Data Engineering and ML teams, you’ll help make training more efficient while reducing one of Wayve’s largest infrastructure costs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Lead a hands-on, multi-quarter storage programme, from defining the problems and architecture to delivering platforms that teams adopt.

- Build production services, controllers and infrastructure using Python, Go or a similar language, alongside Kubernetes and Terraform.

- Partner with ML and data teams to understand access patterns, remove storage bottlenecks and reduce the time GPUs spend waiting for data.

- Work with Security and Privacy to strengthen access controls, auditing and safe deletion of vehicle-collected data.

- Write design documents and RFCs, align teams around shared standards, and mentor engineers as the platform and team grow.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Data ownership and governance: Give datasets clear owners, purposes and retention classes, with tagging and team-level cost attribution.

- Safe lifecycle management: Build retention, deletion and re-tiering capabilities for Azure Blob, backed by dry runs, audit trails and recovery paths.

- Read performance and caching: Improve throughput and latency by tackling small-object reads, throttling, unnecessary data access and cross-region hops.

- Secure data movement: Design Kubernetes-native NVMe caching and secure replication across regions and clouds.

- Measurable platform outcomes: Establish standards, dashboards and SLOs for availability, performance, cache effectiveness, storage tiers and cost.

🙌 You should apply if

- You’ve operated at Staff Engineer scope, leading complex infrastructure programmes across multiple teams from problem definition through adoption.

- You’ve owned petabyte-scale object storage end to end-including data layout, lifecycle management, performance and cost-with measurable outcomes against a cost target.

- You’ve built scalable systems for data ownership, tagging, cataloguing, retention or deletion.

- You bring strong security and access-management experience, including IAM/RBAC, encryption, secure replication and auditing.

- You’re a hands-on software engineer with strong Python, Go or comparable skills, plus production Kubernetes, Terraform and CI experience. You build durable platforms and services, not just one-off scripts.

- You can influence technical decisions without formal authority, mentor others and are excited to start in a founding, hands-on role with the opportunity to grow a team.

- You can work on a hybrid basis from our London office.

Experience with AWS or GCP is welcome-you don’t need to have worked exclusively with Azure.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, NPI
description:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

Wing is looking for a  Staff Technical Program Manager to join our Technical Program Management  team. This role is hybrid based in Palo Alto . We are looking for a high-leverage, outcome-oriented Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Technical Program Management organization. You will lead some of our most critical zero-to-one pilot programs from early technical architecture through full-scale production launch. Additionally, you will serve as the steward of the Product Development Process, driving adoption, standardizing operational rigor across engineering teams, and continuously evolving the framework to scale with our business.

What You’ll Do: 

Drive end-to-end execution of strategic pilot initiatives, transforming ambiguous, early-stage concepts into validated, scalable production systems. Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, QA, and Operations to define technical requirements, milestones, success metrics, and delivery roadmaps. Identify, track, and aggressively de-risk complex technical dependencies, architectural bottlenecks, and cross-functional blockers.

• Serve as the principal owner and evangelist of the engineering Product Development Process (PDP).

• Drive process compliance, alignment, and adoption across all engineering teams, ensuring consistent quality, traceability, and execution rigor.

• Continuously inspect, refine, and modernize the PDP lifecycle (phase gates, design reviews, launch readiness, post-mortems) to eliminate friction and ensure processes stay lean and effective.

• Define and track key operational metrics (e.g., cycle times, release velocity, defect escape rates) to measure PDP health and drive continuous improvements.

What You’ll Need: 

• Experience: 12+ years of technical program management experience, with a proven track record operating at executive level visibility in high-growth, technically complex environments.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience operating in regulated, mission-critical, or hardware-software integrated product environments.

• Ability to establish operational standards and drive compliance through partnership and trust rather than bureaucratic mandates.

• Background in developing internal tooling, dashboards, and automated workflows to track governance and engineering velocity.

• 0-to-1 Delivery: Demonstrated success leading mission-critical technical initiatives from initial prototype/pilot phase through to commercial-scale production.

• Process Leadership: Proven experience designing, rolling out, and governing a formal Product Development Process (PDP) or Stage-Gate framework across multi-disciplinary engineering organizations.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to distill deep technical trade-offs into actionable insights for VP and C-suite stakeholders.

title: Senior InfoSec Analyst

You will detect, investigate, and respond to security events across our corporate and cloud environments. You'll act as a technical lead on incidents, mentor analysts, and work with Engineering, IT, Legal, and Privacy teams to reduce risk.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

• Lead investigations from triage through containment, scoping, remediation, and postmortem for security events

• Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, and cloud and SaaS audit data to distinguish true positives from false positives and reconstruct attacker or user activity timelines

• Investigate credential and secret exposure, endpoint detections, phishing, data exposure, and policy violations such as unauthorized tool or AI usage

• Automate repetitive response work using scripting and APIs, including enrichment, ticketing, and notification workflows

• Maintain runbooks, playbooks, and severity and escalation standards

• Contribute to employee-facing security guidance and awareness

• Mentor junior analysts and help raise the team's investigative and communication standards

• 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or a related field

• Hands-on experience leading incidents end to end, including clear stakeholder communication during and after an event

• Strong log analysis skills in a SIEM and fluency with EDR tools

• Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, or Azure), identity and access management, and SaaS security

• Solid understanding of attacker techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK

• Ability to prioritize and make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure

• Strong written communication, including incident reports and executive-ready summaries

Nice to Have

• Experience integrating LLM or AI tooling into security workflows, or assessing AI-related risk

• Familiarity with incident management platforms and Jira-based workflows

• Relevant certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CISSP, or similar)

• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

Description
Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.
Position Overview
The Senior Advisor, Vaccine & Clinical Case Management will act as a product owner and lead the vision, backlog, and delivery of a new vaccine management and clinical case management system for Massachusetts local health departments. The role sits between local public health practitioners, the Massachusetts Department of Public Health (DPH) Office of Local and Regional Health, and the IT delivery team. The system will support immunization clinics, vaccine inventory and accountability, public health nursing case management, and insurance billing for clinical services. It must align with related DPH platforms' data model, user experience and governance so local health departments experience one coherent set of tools. The ideal candidate has worked inside a local health department and knows firsthand how public health nurses, clinic coordinators, and health directors do their work.
Project Overview
The Massachusetts Department of Public Health (DPH), Office of Local and Regional Health, is building a statewide vaccine management and clinical case management system for the Commonwealth's 351 local health departments. The goal is to develop one modern, secure system that supports clinical public health work from start to finish.
The system will help local health departments:

• Run immunization programs by planning clinics, scheduling patients, documenting vaccine administration and reporting to the Massachusetts Immunization Information System (MIIS).

• Manage vaccine supply through inventory, ordering, lot tracking, cold chain monitoring and accountability for state-supplied vaccines.

• Coordinate nursing case management for tuberculosis, communicable disease follow-up and home visiting, including intake, care plans, visits, referrals and case closure.

• Bill for clinical services by verifying insurance, generating claims and tracking reimbursement from MassHealth, Medicare and commercial payers.

• Report and use data with dashboards and reports for local, regional and state users.

The system is being designed with local public health, not just for it. Public health nurses, clinic staff, and health directors will shape requirements, test features, and guide rollout. The result should reduce administrative burden, strengthen data quality and help departments sustain clinical services across communities of every size with a particular focus on ensuring any solution is effectively implemented in rural communities.

You won't just talk about what's possible with Synthesia; you'll build the sample apps, tutorials, and demos that prove it, and you'll do it consistently enough that developers start to recognize your name before they recognize the logo.

 

You'll be part of the Developer Services team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Developer Support to turn technical capability into developer adoption.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Create technical content that developers actually use

- Write blog posts, tutorials, and how-to guides that show real, working integrations - not just feature announcements

- Build and maintain sample apps, starter kits, and code snippets across common languages and frameworks

- Produce video walkthroughs and livestreams using Synthesia's own product wherever it makes sense to "eat our own dog food"

- Keep a fast, honest cadence - regular, dependable output builds more trust than occasional big launches

Show up where developers are

- Represent Synthesia at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and webinars - as a speaker, workshop host, and booth presence

- Run livestreams and community AMAs that go deep on real implementation questions, not marketing talking points

- Build relationships with individual developers, technical bloggers, and community leaders who influence adoption

- Travel as needed to be physically present in the communities that matter most to our growth

Be the credible technical voice

- Get hands-on with the Synthesia API well enough to build things yourself, debug alongside developers, and speak with authority - not from a script

- Earn trust the way any evangelist does: by being genuinely useful before asking for anything in return

- Play the long game - plant seeds in developer communities today that turn into adoption months or years down the line

At Wonderlic , we believe great work and a fulfilling life should go hand in hand. We’re a remote-first company offering a full-time, 32-hour workweek across four days , giving our team more time to focus on what matters at work and beyond it.

You will be the person in the organization who can hold both the I-O science question and the production ML question in the same breath, and answer both.

title: Strategic Fixer
description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

Our largest customers run complex operations, and when something isn’t working, the problem rarely sits neatly within one team. A customer may be implementing a new product, dealing with a complicated integration, or facing an operational issue with no obvious owner or solution. That’s where you come in!

We’re looking for a Strategic Fixer who wants exposure to a wide range of problems and is ready to own outcomes. You will take ambiguous problems, structure them, dig into the details, align senior stakeholders, and drive execution across teams that don’t report to you.

This isn’t a role where you make a recommendation and hand it off. One week you might be diagnosing a failing payroll integration, the next coordinating an engineering fix, and the next working with a customer’s VP of Operations to get an implementation back on track. The problems might vary, but your job stays the same: figure it out, get the right people moving, and own the problem until it’s solved. This role opens doors to a range of growth paths across Clipboard!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that guide business decisions.

- Research and evaluate new tools, including AI, automation, and internal systems, and drive their adoption to make operations more effective.

- Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience

- Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2-6 years of experience in a problem-solving role, such as strategy or management consulting, operations, strategy & operations, implementation, customer strategy, or program management.

- Experience solving operational problems by improving processes, designing workflows, or building scalable systems, while juggling multiple priorities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data (e.g., SQL, Python) to diagnose problems and support decisions.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex problems simply and align stakeholders across teams, from frontline operators to senior leaders.

- A high level of ownership. You don’t stop at the recommendation; you stay with the problem until it’s solved.

- A deep curiosity that drives you to reason from first principles and dig until you find the root cause.

- A habit of going to the source: testing the feature, listening to the agent call, calling the customer, or running the workflow.

WHY JOIN CLIPBOARD?

- We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

- Fast-paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

- A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

- Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Team:

Working hand-in-hand with our Directed Content and 1x1 Call Services groups, this team provides timely channel checks and voice-of-customer interviews that reveal real-time demand signals, competitive dynamics, and purchasing behavior across priority industry verticals. By identifying the right operator, distributor, or end-customer profiles-and engaging them at the optimal moment in the quarter-we help investors surface differentiated, actionable insights.

 

Channel & Customer Research (CCR) delivers scalable primary research that provides real-time insight into company performance and industry conditions. Through structured interviews with distributors, resellers, suppliers, consultants, and other channel partners, CCR captures the perspectives of professionals directly involved in how products and services move through the market. Leveraging AlphaSense’s AI Interviewer technology, CCR is able to conduct and scale structured expert interviews continuously, expanding coverage while maintaining consistency and analytical rigor. Covering hundreds of companies across major sectors, CCR provides investors and corporate users with channel research that offers a continuous view of demand trends, competitive dynamics, and market conditions as they develop.

 

About the Role:

Analysts are the execution engine for our Channel and Customer Research offering. You will:

• Map the expert universe for assigned verticals

• Source and vet high-value channel partners and customers

• Build long-term relationships with key channel sources

• Coordinate and monitor interviews

• Form sector expertise through regular and consistent research to remain up-to-date on industry trends and news

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
AI Engineer

• Work Type: Full-time.

• Schedule: Standard US business hours.

• Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview
We are seeking a forward-thinking AI Engineer with hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI agents capable of executing complex, multi-step tasks. This role focuses on developing modern agentic systems that combine large language models (LLMs), specialized agent skills, context management, and workflow orchestration to create reliable, scalable AI-powered solutions.
The ideal candidate understands how to move beyond traditional, step-by-step automation to build adaptive AI systems that can reason through tasks, select and use tools, maintain relevant context, and execute workflows with minimal human intervention. This position requires strong software engineering fundamentals, practical hands-on experience with AI agent architectures, and the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready applications using technologies such as TypeScript, React, and n8n.
Key Responsibilities

• AI Agent Development: Design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of handling multi-step tasks, making context-aware decisions, using tools, and adapting their execution based on intermediate results.

• Agent Skills & Tool Integration: Develop reusable agent skills, tools, and capabilities that enable agents to perform specialized tasks, interact with external systems, and execute complex workflows efficiently.

• Context & Memory Management: Implement effective context engineering strategies, including context retrieval, memory management, conversation state, relevant information injection, and context-window optimization to improve agent performance and reliability.

• Agent Orchestration: Build systems that coordinate multiple tools, workflows, and agent capabilities while managing task decomposition, execution sequences, dependencies, error handling, and escalation when necessary.

• AI Workflow Automation: Use n8n and other appropriate technologies to design, connect, and optimize automation workflows that integrate AI models, APIs, business logic, and external applications.

• Full-Stack Development: Use TypeScript and React to develop and integrate AI-powered features into software applications, building reliable interfaces and backend integrations that support agent execution.

• LLM & API Integration: Integrate leading large language models and third-party APIs, selecting appropriate models and implementation approaches based on task complexity, performance, reliability, and cost.

• Evaluation & Optimization: Test and evaluate agent behavior using representative tasks, structured test cases, and measurable performance criteria. Identify failure patterns and continuously improve accuracy, consistency, latency, and execution quality.

• Production Deployment & Monitoring: Deploy AI solutions into production environments, monitor their behavior, troubleshoot failures, and implement safeguards to maintain dependable operation.

• Version Control & Collaboration: Use GitHub and established software development practices to maintain code quality, manage changes, document implementations, and collaborate effectively with the engineering team.

• Continuous Improvement: Stay current with evolving agent frameworks, model capabilities, tool-calling patterns, and context engineering techniques, applying relevant advancements to improve existing solutions.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Professional Experience: 3-5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development of AI-powered applications or intelligent automation systems.

• AI Agent Engineering: Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents beyond basic chatbot implementations or purely linear, rule-based automation workflows, and ability to articulate and walk clients and users through the ai agent development process.

• Agent Skills & Tool Use: Practical understanding

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

The Senior Customer Success Engineer (Senior CSE) is an advanced technical role within the Customer Success organization, serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex, high-impact technical challenges. Building on the foundation of the CSE role, the Senior CSE handles the most technically demanding and strategically significant issues, provides mentorship to CSE peers, and drives the development of scalable processes, tooling, and knowledge assets that elevate the entire team’s capabilities. This pooled, non-billable role supports CSMs across the full Delinea product portfolio (excluding FastPath) and operates with a high degree of autonomy.

• Engage directly with customers at a senior technical level when escalated, representing Delinea’s technical expertise while ensuring the CSM retains the primary relationship.

• Collaborate with CS leadership to shape team processes, define escalation criteria, and establish metrics for measuring CSE impact.

• Stay current on industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive landscape in the PAM and identity security space to inform customer conversations and internal strategy.

• Maintain clear boundaries with Professional Services; this role does not involve billable implementations, custom development, or long-term customer assignments.

Escalation and Assignment Process

Senior CSE engagements follow the same structured process as standard CSE assignments. CSMs escalate needs to the CSE Team, who evaluates relevance. The Senior CSE may also be proactively deployed for high-risk accounts or critical situations at the discretion of CS leadership.
